newsitem.title: USA: BankAmerica promotes former Calif. treasurer.
newsitem.headline: BankAmerica promotes former Calif. treasurer.

text.p: BankAmerica Corp's Bank of America said on Wednesday it promoted Kathleen Brown -- California's former state treasurer -- to executive vice president from senior vice president.

Brown, 51, will continue to serve as managing director of sales and business development for Bank of America's wealth management group, which manages more than $53 billion in assets on behalf of institutions, corporations and individuals. She also leads a Bank of America team developing a program specifically designed to serve women clients.
From 1991 to 1994, Brown served as California's treasurer.
